method_lock.rejected_generic_version: Love is in the little things, shown through cozy props and a clean moral.
method_lock.human_rewrite_rule: Every candidate must land as a behavior someone recognizes, not as a lesson someone agrees with.

premise_lock.task: Generate 3-5 candidate next-carousel ideas for the idea room only.
premise_lock.surface: Instagram 4x5 carousel recommendation, stopping before final prompts or images.
premise_lock.speaker_receiver: Aachu and Zuv as a specific couple; each candidate can be read as one partner sending the post to the other.
premise_lock.audience_job: Make someone send the carousel because it names a private behavior they recognize.
must_keep: source winner or owned-performance evidence remains visible
A Story wrapper is a lived couple scene, not a quote card
must_reject: object-led invention where the object becomes the whole premise
scenes that only work because the caption explains them

candidates.title: The Long Version
candidates.one_line_concept: One partner asks for the full messy vent, not the polite summary.
candidates.exact_first_slide_text: please vent more. i don't want the short version.
candidates.first_frame_visual: A quiet night room. Aachu is mid-rant, one hand caught in explanation. Zuv sits fully turned toward her with his phone face-down, not solving, not scrolling.

mini_arc.text: please vent more. i don't want the short version.
mini_arc.visual: Aachu talking fast on the bed or floor; Zuv's phone is face-down beside him.

mini_arc.text: tell me the same part again.
mini_arc.visual: Zuv shifts closer, chin on hand, listening like the repeated detail matters.

mini_arc.text: you always say 'sorry, i am boring you' right before the real thing comes out.
mini_arc.visual: Aachu looks embarrassed mid-sentence; Zuv does not interrupt.

mini_arc.text: i was not waiting for you to finish. i was staying.
mini_arc.visual: The room is calmer; Aachu's shoulders have dropped; the phone is still untouched.

payoff_frame.text: i was not waiting for you to finish. i was staying.
payoff_frame.visual: Aachu has finally gone quiet beside him, not because she was cut off, because she was heard.

primary.what_stays: The permissioned emotional engine: 'please, vent more' as a direct request.
primary.what_changes: A Story turns it into a four-slide listening scene with a visible phone-face-down receipt.

novelty_model.stale_generic_version: Choose someone who listens to you.
novelty_model.new_reveal: The love is not patience with the vent. It is asking for the version they usually cut short because they feel annoying.
novelty_model.contrast_frame: Polite summary versus the long, repetitive, real version.
novelty_model.closest_proof: The phone stays face-down while the same detail is told again.
novelty_model.viewer_outcome: The overtalker sends it to the person who never made them feel like a burden.
novelty_model.what_not_to_explain: Do not say 'holding space' or teach communication.

candidates.A Story wrapper: Aachu starts to apologize for repeating herself. Zuv quietly makes it clear he came for the long version.
candidates.why_someone_sends_or_comments: The person who over-explains sends it with 'this is you.' The listener can comment that the details are the point.

anti_slop_risk.risk: Could turn into therapy-page listening copy.
anti_slop_risk.rejected_generic_line: Be with someone who makes you feel heard.
anti_slop_risk.repair: Keep the receipt physical: phone down, repeated detail, no advice, no big confession.

candidates.title: Reached?
candidates.one_line_concept: The tiny check-in after someone leaves is the love language nobody makes dramatic.
candidates.first_frame_visual: Aachu stands near a lift lobby or building gate after leaving. Her phone lights up with Zuv's one-word message. She is trying not to smile.

mini_arc.visual: Aachu at the gate with the message visible enough to read.

mini_arc.text: not a speech. just one word after i leave.
mini_arc.visual: Zuv at home, still looking at the chat instead of pretending he forgot.

mini_arc.text: he acts casual. he checks twice.
mini_arc.visual: A second small phone buzz; Aachu smiles before typing back.

mini_arc.text: i reply late just to see if you ask again.
mini_arc.visual: Aachu's thumb hovering over the reply, enjoying being cared for.

payoff_frame.text: i reply late just to see if you ask again.
payoff_frame.visual: The teasing lives in the pause before she replies, not in a big romantic scene.

primary.what_stays: Ordinary care phrases as ways of saying love.
primary.what_changes: A Story narrows it to one relationship receipt: the 'reached?' message.

novelty_model.old_familiar_topic: Checking if your partner got home safely.
novelty_model.stale_generic_version: The little things mean the most.
novelty_model.new_reveal: The check-in is not logistics. It is wanting one more trace of them after they leave.
novelty_model.contrast_frame: A casual safety message versus a small excuse to stay connected.
novelty_model.closest_proof: One-word 'reached?' message and the deliberate late reply.
novelty_model.viewer_outcome: People send it to the partner who always asks, or tease the partner who waits for the double-check.
novelty_model.what_not_to_explain: Do not turn it into a lecture on care or safety.

candidates.A Story wrapper: Zuv checks on Aachu after she leaves; Aachu already knows he will ask again and enjoys the tiny drama.
candidates.why_someone_sends_or_comments: It earns 'you do this' comments from couples with a check-in ritual, and sends from people who want that ordinary care noticed.

anti_slop_risk.risk: Can read controlling if staged as surveillance or anxiety.
anti_slop_risk.rejected_generic_line: Love is someone caring if you got home safe.
anti_slop_risk.repair: Make it mutual and teasing: one-word message, soft smile, no panic, no demand.

candidates.title: The Last Bite Lie
candidates.one_line_concept: One partner leaves the last bite and lies badly about not wanting it.
candidates.exact_first_slide_text: you left me the last bite and lied so badly.
candidates.first_frame_visual: A small table after eating. One last bite is left. Aachu points at it with a suspicious face; Zuv looks away like a terrible actor.

mini_arc.text: you left me the last bite and lied so badly.
mini_arc.visual: Aachu clocks the last bite and Zuv's fake-casual face.

mini_arc.text: you said 'i am full' while still looking at it.
mini_arc.visual: Zuv looks betrayed by his own eyes; Aachu is amused.

mini_arc.text: i ate it like i believed you.
mini_arc.visual: Aachu takes the bite with full awareness; Zuv pretends not to care.

mini_arc.text: some love is very bad at acting.
mini_arc.visual: They both know the lie was the gift.

payoff_frame.text: some love is very bad at acting.
payoff_frame.visual: The humor is in both of them knowing, not in a polished sacrifice reveal.

primary.what_stays: Deep love lives in ordinary meals and quiet sacrifices.
primary.what_changes: A Story replaces the broad poetic claim with one tiny exposed lie.

novelty_model.stale_generic_version: He always saves the best for her.
novelty_model.new_reveal: The romance is not the bite. It is the bad acting around the sacrifice.
novelty_model.contrast_frame: Grand sacrifice versus a tiny lie both people understand.
novelty_model.closest_proof: One last bite, one fake 'i am full,' one partner calling the bluff silently.
novelty_model.viewer_outcome: Couples comment with their own last-bite or last-sip versions.

candidates.A Story wrapper: Aachu and Zuv's private food logic becomes the emotional receipt; the object serves the behavior, not the other way around.
candidates.why_someone_sends_or_comments: It gives both partners a safe tease: the giver gets seen, the receiver gets to admit they knew.

anti_slop_risk.risk: Object-led cleverness if the bite becomes the whole premise.
anti_slop_risk.rejected_generic_line: Real love is saving the last bite.
anti_slop_risk.repair: Keep the focus on the lie, eye contact, and mutual knowing.

candidates.title: Leave Space Beside Me
candidates.one_line_concept: After a fight, one partner says go away but quietly leaves the seat beside them open.
candidates.exact_first_slide_text: when i say 'go', i leave space beside me.
candidates.first_frame_visual: After-fight bedroom or sofa scene. Aachu faces away, visibly upset, but the space beside her is open. Zuv stays near without touching or performing an apology.

mini_arc.text: when i say 'go', i leave space beside me.
mini_arc.visual: Aachu turned away, empty space beside her deliberately visible.

mini_arc.text: not for advice. not for a speech.
mini_arc.visual: Zuv sits at the edge of the space, quiet, hands to himself.

mini_arc.text: just don't make my silence do all the work.
mini_arc.visual: The distance is small enough to feel chosen, big enough to respect the mood.

mini_arc.text: sit near me. i will be angry there.
mini_arc.visual: Aachu remains annoyed, but her shoulder has softened toward him.

payoff_frame.text: sit near me. i will be angry there.
payoff_frame.visual: The payoff is not reconciliation. It is proximity surviving the mood.

primary.what_stays: The high-send A Story engine: dramatic words hiding a request for softness and closeness.
primary.what_changes: This version drops the broad 'calm girl' framing and makes the receipt one open seat.

novelty_model.stale_generic_version: Love is staying even when things are hard.
novelty_model.new_reveal: The first softening can be furniture: the space beside them is still open.
novelty_model.contrast_frame: Go away as spoken words versus stay near as staged body truth.
novelty_model.closest_proof: An empty seat beside an angry person.
novelty_model.viewer_outcome: The dramatic partner sends it because it says the inconvenient truth without apologizing first.
novelty_model.what_not_to_explain: Do not call it attachment, patience, or healthy conflict.

candidates.A Story wrapper: Aachu's anger still has a seat saved for Zuv. Zuv knows the rule and sits close, not smugly, not forcefully.
candidates.why_someone_sends_or_comments: It invites comments like 'unfortunately me' while staying warm enough that the teased partner still sends it back.

anti_slop_risk.risk: Could excuse ignoring boundaries if staged wrong.
anti_slop_risk.rejected_generic_line: Stay with someone who never leaves you in your silence.
anti_slop_risk.repair: Make it an established private couple code: open space, no forced touch, no smug rescue.

top_pick.title: The Long Version
top_pick.why_this_wins: It starts from a permissioned source lead, keeps the winning 'vent more' engine visible, and adds an A Story receipt that can be photographed in one frame: phone face-down, repeated detail, no advice. It is less worn out than 'get home safe' and less object-led than the last-bite idea.
top_pick.first_slide_text: please vent more. i don't want the short version.

scene_landing_preview.first_frame_visual: Aachu mid-rant; Zuv fully turned toward her with phone face-down.
scene_landing_preview.swipe_reason: The viewer wants to see whether the post understands the embarrassment of talking too much.
scene_landing_preview.payoff_frame: i was not waiting for you to finish. i was staying.
scene_landing_preview.share_trigger: Send to the person who listens to the same story again without making you feel like a burden.
scene_landing_preview.flat_risk: If the story room writes it as 'being heard is love,' it dies.
scene_landing_preview.correction_if_flat: Return to the physical receipts: repeated detail, apology for rambling, phone untouched.

rejected_patterns.pattern: Love is in the little things
rejected_patterns.why_rejected: Too worn, too quote-card, and it lets any prop pretend to be specificity.

rejected_patterns.pattern: Choose someone who listens to you
rejected_patterns.why_rejected: Therapy-page moral. No visible couple behavior until rewritten into the phone-down long-version scene.
Trope-only gender joke. The teased partner would not proudly send it.

rejected_patterns.pattern: Food sacrifice as the whole idea
rejected_patterns.why_rejected: Object-led invention unless the emotional action is the bad lie and mutual knowing.
Generic comfort unless the open seat proves the contradiction without explaining it.

risk_notes: No live platform research was run in this pass; local winner bank, owned insights, run brief, and cited brain pages were used.
DZS2GuipLku is present in posts_merged.json rather than the 2026-06-14 ranked index excerpt, so it is treated as a useful source lead with strong comment smell, not the highest-metric bank winner.

DZTTSUBEaRr and DYG9a-FEuBQ have source-level metadata and captions, but no child-slide OCR was available in the queried local records. Story room should avoid pretending slide-level structure was fully inspected.
Candidate 04 needs careful consent/body-language staging so 'go' does not become boundary-ignoring romance.
None of these are final prompts or image instructions; prompt room must still build scene options, identity references, and generation gates after idea lock.

rubric.relatability: Would a real couple say 'this is us'?
rubric.emotional_truth: Does the behavior carry feeling without a lecture?
rubric.specificity: Could this only belong to a private couple pattern?
rubric.warmth: Would the teased partner still send it?
rubric.everyday_visual_evidence: Can the first frame prove the premise?
rubric.brand_fit: Does it fit Aachu/Zuv and A Story restraint?
rubric.stereotype_safety: Higher means lower risk of lazy gender or partner trope.
rubric.novelty: Old feeling made newly visible without bait.

scores.selection_note: All four pass the 4.0 idea-room threshold; top pick is strongest because the source engine, visible receipt, and send reason are clearest.
